script:
set -Eeuo pipefail
install -d -m 700 /opt/karpo/.ssh
if [ ! -e /opt/karpo/.ssh/rps-h100 ]; then
 ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C karpo-rps100-private-control -f /opt/karpo/.ssh/rps-h100
fi
cp /opt/karpo/.ssh/rps-h100.pub /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/setup/control-public-key.txt
aws s3 cp /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/setup/control-public-key.txt s3://karpo-benchmark-20261119-115003-632930644527/results/vllm-rps100-20261120/setup/control-public-key.txt --region us-east-1 --no-progress
